serialSearchInfo.infoDescription: Learn how to search credits using serial numbers.
serialSearchInfo.intro: You can search using any of the following:
serialSearchInfo.fullSerialDescription: Enter the complete serial to find the exact block.
serialSearchInfo.fullSerialRangeDescription: You can also enter a full serial with a single credit as the range (start and end the same) to find the block that contains that credit.
serialSearchInfo.singleCreditDescription: Enter one number to find blocks whose serial range contains that credit.
serialSearchInfo.numberRangeDescription: Enter two numbers to find blocks whose range overlaps that window, or three numbers to also filter by vintage. The first number must be smaller than the second.
serialSearchInfo.serialPrefixDescription: Start typing a serial from the beginning to narrow results as you type; you can stop at any point.
serialSearchInfo.textFragmentDescription: Enter any part of the serial, like an organization or country code to find blocks containing that text.
